name: prompt-templates
description: Prompt template library in a pane: search, tags, {{variables}}, fill, insert, send or copy; /prompts

libraryFile.title: Library file (.json)
libraryFile.description: Keep the templates in this JSON file instead of the plugin store, for example ~/.claude/prompt-templates.json in a folder you sync with git. Empty keeps them in the plugin store. A missing file is created from the stored templates on first use.
